observed_problem: The generic Retrospective Period helper validated that start <= end but did not require the Profile as_of/initialization instant to be at or after the bounded period end. A custom or future configured retrospective could therefore initialize while part of its declared period was still in the future.
expected_behavior: RETROSPECTIVE_PERIOD represents completed bounded history. Deterministic initialization must fail closed unless as_of is at or after the period end. This is analogous to Weekly refusing an issue whose configured editorial cutoff has not yet occurred.
actual_behavior: scripts/survey_period_v2.py now rejects Profile creation/initialization whenever the resolved as_of instant precedes the bounded period end. Configured and custom Period paths share the same guard. The regression suite includes an incomplete future-period case that must fail before initialization.

provenance.human_review_reference: Post-change five-perspective audit requested by Owner, 2026-08-22

improvement_action: Required as_of >= bounded-period end before Retrospective Period Profile creation/initialization and added a fail-closed regression.
